overview.description: The MFS Blended Research International Equity ETF (BRIE) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF that targets large-cap equity securities from around the world, excluding the US, based on fundamental and quantitative research. BRIE was launched on Oct 22, 2025 and is issued by MFS.
